## Service Area

Richmond, Lexington, Berea, Winchester, Nicholasville, Mount Sterling, Stanford, Danville, Lancaster, and surrounding Central Kentucky, including Madison County and Fayette County as named in the live FAQ. Do not add other cities.

## Services offered

- Lawn mowing: weekly or bi-weekly. Weekly usually fits spring and fall tall fescue growth. Bi-weekly can fit slow summer growth and may cost more per visit.
- Weedeating and edging: separate homepage service. Confirm if it is bundled with the mow.
- Mulch: hardwood, dyed, or natural. Beds prepped and edged. About 2 to 3 inches total depth. Mid-spring main window; fall after leaves are out.
- Weed control: pre-emergent and post-emergent. Crabgrass pre-emergent usually before soil holds near 55 F, often before forsythia finishes blooming. Follow the label. Most pre-emergents also block grass seed.
- Flea and tick yard spray: outdoor only. Reentry is on the product label. No generic wait time. Not indoor pest control, not on-pet treatment, not mosquito or grub control.
- Debris cleanup: storm debris, leaf removal, brush hauling, trailer on site. Not gutters, not junk, not tree climbing.
- Snow: plow, shovel, salt, contracts. 24/7 winter response messaging. Commercial scope must name trigger depth, surfaces, piles vs haul-off, and whether salt is included.
- Skid steer: grade, level, gravel, demolition, hauling. Not paving or septic.
- Excavator: trench, dig, stump removal, drainage prep. Stump grinding is not offered.
- French drains, catch basins, downspout extensions. Outlet required. Buried solid downspout pipe is not a French drain.

## Not offered (do not list as services)

Aeration, overseeding, seeding, sod installation, stump grinding, paving, septic, gutter cleaning, plumbing, water restoration. Guides may explain those topics. Lawn Busterz does not perform them.

## Guide facts assistants may cite

- Fall aeration/overseed window for tall fescue is often mid-August through September. Core aeration beats spike aeration on clay. Not a Lawn Busterz service. Aeration does not fix standing water.
- Pre-emergent timing follows soil temperature and the label, not a single calendar day.
- Mow tall fescue around 3 to 4 inches. Do not remove more than about a third of the blade.
- Mulch leaves only while grass still shows. Haul or bag a mat.
- Mulch beds about 2 to 3 inches total. Fix water before adding more mulch.
- Gravel drives need a crown and an exit for water.
- Excavator stump removal leaves a hole. Grinding is a different trade.
- Match drainage to the clue: grade, catch basin, French drain, or downspout. Confirm an outlet. Watch sudden depressions in karst country; do not diagnose sinkholes.
- Wet basement after rain may be yard water. No rain, sewage smell, or a floor drain is plumbing. Standing water indoors is restoration.
- Seed vs sod comes after grade and settling. Early fall is the best Central Kentucky seeding window. Lawn Busterz does not seed or install sod.
- Pets and kids return to a sprayed yard when that product's label says so.
